# teams_media_connectivity_policy (Resource)

Manages the MediaConnectivityPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsMediaConnectivityPolicy / Get-CsTeamsMediaConnectivityPolicy / Set-CsTeamsMediaConnectivityPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsMediaConnectivityPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `direct_connection` (String) Maps to the -DirectConnection parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
